text:
maya: Kicking off rollout for `route-cohort-x` in the 21:00 UTC change window. Plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% with 10m gates. We'll soft-pin model v7.0.2 for exposed cohort and autoswap to v6.9.8 on errors.

deploybot: queued job 20241005-rcx-01 for 2024-10-05T21:00:00Z; will emit events for each step.

rafael: Rollback triggers suggestion: immediate drain if p95 > 300ms OR 5xx increase > 0.8% sustained for 4m. Also drain on auto-quality-eval fail. Keep an eye on tokens/sec drop.

ops_bot: Monitors set (latency_p95, 5xx_rate, token_loss_rate). Alert: page on sev1 if p95 > 600ms OR 5xx > 2% for 3m. Runbook: https://wiki/internal/ff-playbooks#route-cohort-x

claire: Release note blurb: "Staged ramp of route-cohort-x to validate model v7.0.2 routing; soft-pin per-step w/ fallback to v6.9.8." Uploading draft now. :memo:

maya: Ops checklist:
```
- t+0 set route-cohort-x = 1% and enable soft-pin model=v7.0.2 (8m)
- wait 10m, run smoke prompts, verify p95/5xx/tokens/sec/quality
- t+10 bump to 5% if green, keep soft-pin 8m
- t+20 bump to 25% if green, then cooldown 30m
- fast-disable: `releases flag set route-cohort-x 0 --immediate`
```

rafael: I'll run the A/B quality evals after each bump and post short diffs.

deploybot: step1 executed: route-cohort-x = 1% (7234561300). Next scheduled bump in 10m.

ops_bot: Telemetry snapshot: p95 +9ms, 5xx flat, token_loss +0.05%. Within gates.

claire: noted — standing by for final release note update.

rafael: smoke pass #1: quality evals OK, slight kv-miss uptick +0.3% but no user impact. Green to proceed.

maya: proceeding to 5% now. Calling before action.

deploybot: step2 executed: route-cohort-x = 5% (7234561400). Holding for gating checks.

maya: If any threshold breaches, we fast-disable and pin back to v6.9.8. Ops oncall: @rafael, @maya. Closing thread once cooldown is complete. :white_check_mark:
